lines.text: Jesus teaches in towns and villages on the way to Jerusalem and says to enter through the narrow door.
The master shuts the door and tells those knocking outside, 'I do not know where you are from.'
The ones thrown out will see Moses, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God.
Pharisees warn Jesus that Herod wants to kill Him, but He says He will keep driving out demons and healing.
Jesus longs to gather Jerusalem's children as an eagle gathers chicks under her wings, and says their house is desolate.
